# firstboot_ssh_key (Resource)

An SSH public key that can be injected into a server at creation.

Keys belong to the ORGANIZATION, not to the member who added them: another member can select this key when creating a server, and deleting it here removes it for everyone. Removing a key does not touch servers already built with it, which keep their own snapshot of the keys they were born with.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) A label, shown in the panel's key picker.
- `public_key` (String) The public key in `authorized_keys` form, e.g. `ssh-ed25519 AAAA… name@host`.

The API normalises what it stores (it parses the key and re-serialises it), so this value stays exactly as written in the configuration and is never read back. A change replaces the key.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `fingerprint` (String) SHA256 fingerprint, computed by the API from the parsed key. This is the value to compare against `ssh-keygen -lf`.
- `id` (String) The key's UUID.
